<thought>Based on the single measurement (16.364 Ω between B and X2) and the note that the three resistors are in a 1 : 2 : 3 ratio and labeled left‑to‑right (R1, R2, R3), the simplest topology is a series chain from X2 to B. The total resistance of series resistors is the sum, so 6 k = 16.364 Ω → k ≈ 2.727 Ω. Thus R1 ≈ 2.727 Ω, R2 ≈ 5.455 Ω, R3 ≈ 8.182 Ω. This series topology reproduces the measured resistance exactly.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 2.727, "R2": 5.455, "R3": 8.182}, "connections": [["X2","N1","R1"], ["N1","N2","R2"], ["N2","B","R3"]]}</final_answer>
